headline: September spam update completes after 14 days as four independent experts report a spike in manual actions; Google quietly launches a UGC Fresh Data Program | 9 月垃圾更新历时 14 天结束，四方独立报告手动处罚激增；Google 悄然推出 UGC 新鲜数据项目

Confirmed Search Updates.what_happened: September 2026 spam update rollout complete Oct 8 after ~14 days — the longest of the year's four | 9 月垃圾内容更新 10/8 完成，历时约 14 天，是今年四次中最长的
Confirmed Search Updates.why_it_matters: 现在可以做前后对照了：比较 9/10–9/23 与 10/9 之后两周的点击。14 天的长度说明这次不是单一分类器的小修。
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence: official: Google Search Status incident updated Oct 8; @googlesearchc completion notice; SEJ
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence_detail: Google Search Status marked the September 2026 spam update complete on Oct 8, 2026, roughly 14 days after it began on Sep 24; Search Central posted the completion on X. SEJ notes this is longer than any of the three earlier 2026 spam updates (Mar 24–25, Jun 24–26, Aug 18–21). Google publishes no data on affected sites or targeted behaviours; Lily Ray reports rank trackers are too unreliable at the moment to share findings.
Confirmed Search Updates.what_to_do: 对比更新前两周（9/10–9/23）与结束后两周的 GSC 点击按目录；下跌集中的目录对照 spam policies（scaled content、site reputation、expired domain）。

Confirmed Search Updates.what_happened: Google launches the UGC Fresh Data Program: approved high-volume UGC platforms push new posts and engagement signals to Search via OAuth + JSON-LD, 'ideally within minutes' | Google 推出 UGC 新鲜数据项目：获批的大型 UGC 平台通过 OAuth + JSON-LD 把新帖与互动信号推送给搜索，“最好在数分钟内”
Confirmed Search Updates.why_it_matters: 这是 Reddit 式内容进入搜索的专用通道，独立于 Indexing API。门槛是“高流量 + 大用户群”，中小论坛大概率不够格，但它表明 Google 想要的 UGC 形态：独立稳定 URL、公开作者页、积极审核。
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence: official doc: developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ugc-fresh-data-program (added Oct 8); verified against the live doc Oct 10
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence_detail: Google's new doc describes a dedicated ingestion pipeline and six eligibility criteria: primarily UGC/social/forum content on dedicated stable URLs (not profile or feed pages); high volume and a significant user base (no numbers given); public, Googlebot-accessible content with no login or paywall and a public profile for every creator; OAuth 2.0 plus strictly validated JSON-LD using existing SocialMediaPosting/DiscussionForumPosting markup with interactionStatistic; no illegal content, active moderation and user reporting; content sent ideally within minutes with engagement counters updated within 72 hours. Apply via a Google Form, reply in 6–8 weeks, acceptance not guaranteed. Google named no platforms and published no blog post.
Confirmed Search Updates.what_to_do: UGC 平台：对照六项条件自检（尤其独立 URL、公开作者页、DiscussionForumPosting + interactionStatistic 标记），达标的提交申请；不达标的先把结构化数据补齐。

Official Explanations.what_happened: Google's helpful-content doc now calls fabricated author profiles (AI headshots, invented names, false credentials) 'a form of deception' and a low-quality signal | Google 帮助文档将虚构作者（AI 头像、编造姓名、虚假资历）定性为“欺骗”和低质量信号
Official Explanations.why_it_matters: “专家作者”包装是过去两年内容农场的标配。文档没有说这是垃圾政策，但明确称其为自动化质量系统的负面信号，与 10/1–10/2 的改动是一套。
Official Explanations.evidence: official doc: creating-helpful-content → 'Who (created the content)' paragraph; verified against the live doc Oct 10; surfaced by Search Engine Roundtable (Oct 6)
Official Explanations.evidence_detail: A new paragraph under 'Who (created the content)' lists three fabrication examples — AI-generated headshots, made-up names and false credentials used 'to make content appear as if it was written by human experts' — and states that any form of deception makes a page untrustworthy to users and to Google's automated quality systems and is a signal of a low-quality page. It is guidance, not a named spam policy or manual-action category, and no enforcement details are given. Search Engine Roundtable surfaced it Oct 6 (SEJ had the wording Oct 2); the cited source is Dawn Anderson's retweet.
Official Explanations.what_to_do: 清点作者页：移除或替换 AI 生成头像与虚构署名，补上可验证的资历链接（LinkedIn、学会、作品）；外包内容注明真实作者或改为机构署名。

SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_happened: Four independent practitioners report a spike in manual actions (thin content, pure spam, scaled content), many on long-standing legitimate businesses | 四位独立从业者报告手动处罚激增（thin content、pure spam、scaled content），不少是经营多年的正规企业
SERP & Algorithm Signals.why_it_matters: 手动处罚不是算法波动，恢复以月计且需要复审。即便只是传闻，去 GSC 看一眼手动操作面板的成本为零，所以这一个动作给 P0；全站审计仍是 P1。
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence: observation: Marie Haynes (Oct 6), Daniel Foley Carter via Lily Ray (Oct 7), Glenn Gabe (Oct 8), Search Engine Roundtable (Oct 8); no Google statement
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence_detail: Marie Haynes says requests for manual-action help went 'from essentially no requests to several per week', mostly thin content, pure spam and scaled content, on legitimate long-standing sites — reminiscent of the 2011–12 unnatural-links wave. Glenn Gabe sees the same mix in his inbound; Daniel Foley Carter lists more actions 'popping up'; Barry Schwartz collected about a dozen recent Help Community threads. There is no Google statement and no baseline count, the timing coincides with the spam update (a confound), and consultant inboxes are a biased sample. Carter's claim that actions follow quality-rater visits is incorrect — raters do not issue manual actions.
SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_to_do: 立即打开 GSC → 安全与手动操作 → 手动操作，确认为空；有通知的先读具体类型，不要先改站。然后把 scaled content / thin content 审计排进本周。

SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_happened: Rank trackers are failing: Google's scraper blocking (since ~Sep 13) cut one vendor's data ~80%; SISTRIX collects at a reduced rate; experts can't verify the spam update's impact | 排名追踪工具失灵：Google 自 9/13 起加强反爬，一家厂商数据量掉约 80%，SISTRIX 降速采集，专家无法核实垃圾更新影响
SERP & Algorithm Signals.why_it_matters: 你看到的排名波动可能是工具缺数据而不是 Google 变化。更新结束后的判断要以 GSC 为准，第三方排名数据这几周只能看方向。
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence: observation: Nozzle, DataForSEO, SISTRIX status page (via Search Engine Roundtable, Sep 18); Lily Ray & Glenn Gabe (Oct 8)
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence_detail: Barry Schwartz reported on Sep 18 that blocking stepped up around Sep 13: Derek Perkins (Nozzle) saw about an 80% drop in obtainable data, DataForSEO similar, and SISTRIX's status page said collection was running at a reduced rate; Glenn Gabe noted Ahrefs caught a site's recovery that Semrush lagged on and SISTRIX missed. On Oct 8 Lily Ray said rank trackers were too unreliable to share spam-update findings, and Glenn Gabe observed that even incognito searching now hits CAPTCHAs. Google has not commented; the evidence is two vendors plus practitioner reports.
SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_to_do: 更新影响评估一律以 GSC（点击/展示/平均排名）为主，第三方排名数据只看相对趋势；向你的排名工具供应商索要近 30 天的数据覆盖率说明。

Research & Retrieval.what_happened: Profound: the median AI citation loses half its share within 11 days of peaking; 78% of pages decay within 14 days (883K pages, 7 engines, 12 months) | Profound：AI 引用在达峰后 11 天内中位数份额减半，78% 的页面 14 天内衰减（88.3 万页、7 个引擎、12 个月）
Research & Retrieval.why_it_matters: 如果 AI 引用是“过期”而不是“累积”的，GEO 就更像新闻发行节奏而不是一次性优化；但方法上的 14 天平滑让 78% 这个数字部分是定义使然。
Research & Retrieval.evidence: vendor dataset: 883,000 pages, 1.19M page-engine lifecycles, Kaplan-Meier survival (Profound, ~Sep 30); shared by @sitebulb
Research & Retrieval.evidence_detail: Profound sampled 883,000 cited pages (1 in 128) across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini and Copilot from Sep 2025 to Sep 2026 and modelled 1,188,816 page-engine citation lifecycles with Kaplan-Meier survival on a 14-day trailing share. Median half-life after peak: 11 days; 78% fall to half within 14 days, the rest median 27–29 days; pages cited by 5+ engines survive 5.5× longer at day 56; cross-engine decay correlation is near zero (0.03–0.09). Caveats: the 14-day smoothing mechanically caps burst pages at ≤14 days, share is measured within Profound's own prompt panel, and no author is named. Profound sells the tracking platform.
Research & Retrieval.what_to_do: 监控：对你被 AI 引用最多的 10 个页面记录引用首次出现日和消失日；若多数在两周内消失，把更新频率而非页面数量作为 GEO 的 KPI。

Playbook: Worth Testing.what_happened: Playbook: submit every major child sitemap to Search Console individually, not just the sitemap index, to get per-sitemap indexing coverage | 玩法：在 Search Console 逐个提交主要子 sitemap，而不只提交索引文件，以获得分 sitemap 的索引覆盖数据
Playbook: Worth Testing.why_it_matters: 只提交 sitemap index 时 GSC 把所有 URL 聚合成一份报表，看不出是哪个模板/目录没被索引。逐个提交零成本，诊断粒度立刻细到目录级。
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence: practitioner tip from large-site audits (Brodie Clark, @brodieseo, Oct 6)
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence_detail: Brodie Clark's observation from auditing large sites: when only sitemap-index.xml is submitted, Search Console groups everything into one macro report, so the first bottleneck is aggregate data. Submitting each major child sitemap (products, categories, articles, etc.) individually gives separate Page Indexing views per sitemap. This is a reporting-granularity change, not a ranking tactic; no uplift is claimed.
Playbook: Worth Testing.what_to_do: 在 GSC → Sitemaps 里把每个主要子 sitemap（商品、品类、文章…）单独提交；一周后按 sitemap 看“已抓取未索引”占比，定位问题模板。
Playbook: Worth Testing.how_to_test: 逐个提交子 sitemap → 7 天后在页面索引报告里按 sitemap 筛选 → 比较各模板的未索引比例。
Playbook: Worth Testing.success_metric: 能按模板看到未索引比例与原因分布；随后针对性修复的模板索引率提升。
Playbook: Worth Testing.effort: 极低：几分钟操作；无风险。

sources.name: @brodieseo
sources.excerpt: SEO tip: Never submit just the sitemap index in Google Search Console. Always submit every major child sitemap individually as well. When auditing large sites, the first bottleneck is often aggregate data. If only sitemap-index.xml is submitted, GSC groups everything into a single macro report. You lose section-by-section visibility. Break out and submit individual sitemaps by template or content type: • Products • Category / taxonomy pages • Articles by year/date • Help center & guides In GSC’s Page Indexing report, you can filter by "Submitted pages only" for any specifically submitted sitemap. Instead of guessing why 100k URLs are "Crawled - currently not indexed," you can immediately…
sources.author: @brodieseo

signals.what_happened: Google launches the UGC Fresh Data Program: approved high-volume UGC platforms push new posts and engagement signals to Search via OAuth + JSON-LD, 'ideally within minutes' | Google 推出 UGC 新鲜数据项目：获批的大型 UGC 平台通过 OAuth + JSON-LD 把新帖与互动信号推送给搜索，“最好在数分钟内”
signals.why_it_matters: 这是 Reddit 式内容进入搜索的专用通道，独立于 Indexing API。门槛是“高流量 + 大用户群”，中小论坛大概率不够格，但它表明 Google 想要的 UGC 形态：独立稳定 URL、公开作者页、积极审核。
signals.evidence: official doc: developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ugc-fresh-data-program (added Oct 8); verified against the live doc Oct 10
signals.evidence_detail: Google's new doc describes a dedicated ingestion pipeline and six eligibility criteria: primarily UGC/social/forum content on dedicated stable URLs (not profile or feed pages); high volume and a significant user base (no numbers given); public, Googlebot-accessible content with no login or paywall and a public profile for every creator; OAuth 2.0 plus strictly validated JSON-LD using existing SocialMediaPosting/DiscussionForumPosting markup with interactionStatistic; no illegal content, active moderation and user reporting; content sent ideally within minutes with engagement counters updated within 72 hours. Apply via a Google Form, reply in 6–8 weeks, acceptance not guaranteed. Google named no platforms and published no blog post.
signals.what_to_do: UGC 平台：对照六项条件自检（尤其独立 URL、公开作者页、DiscussionForumPosting + interactionStatistic 标记），达标的提交申请；不达标的先把结构化数据补齐。

signals.what_happened: Four independent practitioners report a spike in manual actions (thin content, pure spam, scaled content), many on long-standing legitimate businesses | 四位独立从业者报告手动处罚激增（thin content、pure spam、scaled content），不少是经营多年的正规企业
signals.why_it_matters: 手动处罚不是算法波动，恢复以月计且需要复审。即便只是传闻，去 GSC 看一眼手动操作面板的成本为零，所以这一个动作给 P0；全站审计仍是 P1。
signals.evidence: observation: Marie Haynes (Oct 6), Daniel Foley Carter via Lily Ray (Oct 7), Glenn Gabe (Oct 8), Search Engine Roundtable (Oct 8); no Google statement
signals.evidence_detail: Marie Haynes says requests for manual-action help went 'from essentially no requests to several per week', mostly thin content, pure spam and scaled content, on legitimate long-standing sites — reminiscent of the 2011–12 unnatural-links wave. Glenn Gabe sees the same mix in his inbound; Daniel Foley Carter lists more actions 'popping up'; Barry Schwartz collected about a dozen recent Help Community threads. There is no Google statement and no baseline count, the timing coincides with the spam update (a confound), and consultant inboxes are a biased sample. Carter's claim that actions follow quality-rater visits is incorrect — raters do not issue manual actions.
signals.what_to_do: 立即打开 GSC → 安全与手动操作 → 手动操作，确认为空；有通知的先读具体类型，不要先改站。然后把 scaled content / thin content 审计排进本周。

signals.what_happened: Playbook: submit every major child sitemap to Search Console individually, not just the sitemap index, to get per-sitemap indexing coverage | 玩法：在 Search Console 逐个提交主要子 sitemap，而不只提交索引文件，以获得分 sitemap 的索引覆盖数据
signals.why_it_matters: 只提交 sitemap index 时 GSC 把所有 URL 聚合成一份报表，看不出是哪个模板/目录没被索引。逐个提交零成本，诊断粒度立刻细到目录级。
signals.evidence: practitioner tip from large-site audits (Brodie Clark, @brodieseo, Oct 6)
signals.evidence_detail: Brodie Clark's observation from auditing large sites: when only sitemap-index.xml is submitted, Search Console groups everything into one macro report, so the first bottleneck is aggregate data. Submitting each major child sitemap (products, categories, articles, etc.) individually gives separate Page Indexing views per sitemap. This is a reporting-granularity change, not a ranking tactic; no uplift is claimed.
signals.what_to_do: 在 GSC → Sitemaps 里把每个主要子 sitemap（商品、品类、文章…）单独提交；一周后按 sitemap 看“已抓取未索引”占比，定位问题模板。
signals.how_to_test: 逐个提交子 sitemap → 7 天后在页面索引报告里按 sitemap 筛选 → 比较各模板的未索引比例。
signals.success_metric: 能按模板看到未索引比例与原因分布；随后针对性修复的模板索引率提升。
signals.effort: 极低：几分钟操作；无风险。

sources.name: @brodieseo
sources.excerpt: SEO tip: Never submit just the sitemap index in Google Search Console. Always submit every major child sitemap individually as well. When auditing large sites, the first bottleneck is often aggregate data. If only sitemap-index.xml is submitted, GSC groups everything into a single macro report. You lose section-by-section visibility. Break out and submit individual sitemaps by template or content type: • Products • Category / taxonomy pages • Articles by year/date • Help center & guides In GSC’s Page Indexing report, you can filter by "Submitted pages only" for any specifically submitted sitemap. Instead of guessing why 100k URLs are "Crawled - currently not indexed," you can immediately…
sources.author: @brodieseo

signals.what_happened: Profound: the median AI citation loses half its share within 11 days of peaking; 78% of pages decay within 14 days (883K pages, 7 engines, 12 months) | Profound：AI 引用在达峰后 11 天内中位数份额减半，78% 的页面 14 天内衰减（88.3 万页、7 个引擎、12 个月）
signals.why_it_matters: 如果 AI 引用是“过期”而不是“累积”的，GEO 就更像新闻发行节奏而不是一次性优化；但方法上的 14 天平滑让 78% 这个数字部分是定义使然。
signals.evidence: vendor dataset: 883,000 pages, 1.19M page-engine lifecycles, Kaplan-Meier survival (Profound, ~Sep 30); shared by @sitebulb
signals.evidence_detail: Profound sampled 883,000 cited pages (1 in 128) across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini and Copilot from Sep 2025 to Sep 2026 and modelled 1,188,816 page-engine citation lifecycles with Kaplan-Meier survival on a 14-day trailing share. Median half-life after peak: 11 days; 78% fall to half within 14 days, the rest median 27–29 days; pages cited by 5+ engines survive 5.5× longer at day 56; cross-engine decay correlation is near zero (0.03–0.09). Caveats: the 14-day smoothing mechanically caps burst pages at ≤14 days, share is measured within Profound's own prompt panel, and no author is named. Profound sells the tracking platform.
signals.what_to_do: 监控：对你被 AI 引用最多的 10 个页面记录引用首次出现日和消失日；若多数在两周内消失，把更新频率而非页面数量作为 GEO 的 KPI。
